assets.name: Capitaine de la couronne
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original full-body fantasy warrior character sprite for the tactical card game Sylve, genuinely alpha-transparent background. This is a complete redesign of the Capitaine de la couronne as a clearly mature adult BLONDE woman aged 35 with a voluptuous curvy build and a very large full bust. She is an imposing, strong royal military commander with a beautiful mature face, blue eyes, defined brows, long golden-blonde hair in a thick side braid continuing into a high ponytail, and a firm self-assured expression. Depict her adult body type naturally in fully opaque, practical fantasy armor, with a generously fitted single-piece black-steel cuirass over an ivory gambeson, broad supportive chest tailoring, a golden ochre sash, dark armored leggings, plated greaves and boots, and a short burgundy shoulder cape. No exposed torso. She carries a straight royal longsword and a memorable OCHRE-ORANGE battle standard with one dark sun emblem. Her personality is brave, commanding and proud. The reference image supplies ONLY the established hand-painted rendering, black-steel/ochre/burgundy palette, banner silhouette and grounded fantasy materials; do not copy the old short gray hair, face or slim body. COMMON tier: relatively simple worn steel armor with just a few bronze clasps, a plain smaller banner and a practical sword, no crown or magical aura. Pose: relaxed full-body front three-quarter guard, banner planted vertically at one side, sword lowered at the other, steady mature face and restrained authority. Polished hand-painted 2D fantasy game illustration with rich dimensional material shading, clear broad color blocks and a crisp readable silhouette at 150 pixels. Balanced full-body character portrait, not a cropped anatomy close-up. Keep the entire hair, banner, sword, boots and body inside a square canvas with generous transparent margins. No scene, ground, card frame, text, lettering, logo, watermark or checkerboard.
